subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: Sohel said to Ishadi, "Friend, have you ever visited the National Memorial at Savar in Dhaka? Wow, how splendid it is!" "Yes, I haven't yet gone there. But I must visit there after the SSC exam is over." "It has been built in memory of the martyrs of our Liberation War. May God bless their souls," Sohel said.
guide_solution: Changing the form of speech Addressing Ishadi as friend, Sohel asked if he had ever visited the National Memorial at Savar in Dhaka. He (S) exclaimed with wonder that it is very splendid. Having replied in the affirmative, Ishadi agreed with Sohel. He (I) added that he hadn't yet gone there and added that he had to visit there after the SSC exam was over. Then Sohel said that it had been built in Memory of the martyrs of our Liberation War. He (S) prayed that God might bless their souls.
